scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:client" "npm run start:server" "npm run start:ai"
scripts.setup:ai: python3 -m venv ai-server/.venv && ai-server/.venv/bin/pip install -r ai-server/requirements.txt
scripts.start:ai: cd ai-server && (test -x .venv/bin/python || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
